result:
Clean lint, clean typecheck, and the full test suite (617 tests) still passes. All edits are complete:

- **Reserved/short/non-Latin names** (`src/lib/slug.ts`, `src/server/services/organization-service.ts`): `uniqueSlug()` now also rejects candidates shorter than the minimum length, and `createOrganization` validates the *derived, unique* slug instead of the raw pre-dedup one — so "Admin", "Al", "J", "山田" etc. get a usable suffixed/fallback slug instead of an exception.
- **Email case** (`src/server/repositories/user-repository.ts`): `findUserByEmail` and `insertUser` now lowercase at the repository boundary itself, so lookups and storage agree regardless of caller.
- **Sign-up throttling / wrong rate-limit message** (`src/server/services/auth-service.ts`, `src/lib/errors.ts`, `src/actions/auth/login.ts`, `src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts`): sign-up is now charged against a new `auth:register` bucket before any writes; login/reset no longer double-charge (removed the duplicate action-layer `consumeRateLimit`); and `RateLimitedError` is now mapped by `toAppError` to the `rate_limited` code instead of falling through to "Something went wrong."
- **Duplicate-address handling** (`src/lib/errors.ts`, `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`): added `DuplicateEmailError` (code `conflict`) so a taken address is refused consistently with a proper 409, matching ADR 0003.
- **Long names breaking workspace settings** (`src/schemas/organization.ts`, `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`): extracted `ORGANIZATION_NAME_MAX_LENGTH`, and sign-up now truncates the display name so `"<name>'s workspace"` always fits that limit.
